league_run_note: Third room. a1 used party v1 (325's manifest, copied as party_league96.json) and lost; a2 used the rebuilt v2 (Incineroar/Chi-Yu/Kingambit/Xerneas/Rillaboom/Raging Bolt). Rebuild reason: v1's Flutter Mane (Sucker Punch/Shadow Ball fodder), Iron Bundle (Ice into Ice) and Urshifu-SS (4x Fairy) were liabilities in the snow room; v2 keeps the Phoebe answers (Dark, Fake Out, Intimidate). Xerneas enters at L84 - the preparation API applies a legend penalty (cap 96 -> 84). Real-run carry after this room with v2: Incineroar, Chi-Yu, Xerneas fainted (Revives); Rillaboom 20/388; Kingambit and Raging Bolt full. Chi-Yu Heat Wave and Xerneas Geomancy (Power Herb consumed - no second Geomancy in Drake's room without a Center) are the carry costs.

attempts.notes: AI switched Kyurem out on T1 into Sandslash to dodge Moonblast (Sandslash resists Fairy); Ninetales set Aurora Veil T1. Urshifu OHKO'd on a switch-in by Ninetales Moonblast (4x). Specs Kyurem Earth Power OHKO'd Incineroar. Chien-Pao Sacred Sword OHKO'd Chi-Yu, Mega Froslass reset snow and swept with Blizzard/Shadow Ball. Baxcalibur never needed.

Fake Out on Ninetales + Heat Wave crit KO'd Ninetales before Aurora Veil; Kyurem Earth Power OHKO'd Incineroar from full (378). Power Herb Geomancy Xerneas + Dark Pulse removed Kyurem; Dazzling Gleam KO'd Mega Froslass and broke Chien-Pao's Sash, Sandslash Iron Head OHKO'd Xerneas (2x, Sword of Ruin). Kingambit (Supreme Overlord +40%) Sucker Punch and Raging Bolt Thunderclap closed on Sandslash and Baxcalibur.

strategy_checks.check: Snow live on entry; Aurora Veil turn 1
strategy_checks.evidence: a1 T1 Aurora Veil (Light Clay, lasted through T8). a2: Ninetales was Fake Out-flinched and KO'd T1; chosen move was Aurora Veil.

strategy_checks.check: Kyurem Specs offense / Blizzard accuracy in snow
strategy_checks.evidence: Kyurem never used Blizzard while I had a Fire type on the board; it chose Earth Power twice (OHKO on Incineroar a1 T5 and a2 T1) and a T1 switch-out in a1 to dodge Moonblast. Sensible reads.
a1 T7 and a2 T3: Froslass Mega Evolved and Snow Warning restarted snow after the first snow had expired (a1) / was still up (a2).

strategy_checks.check: Slush Rush Sandslash uses doubled speed
strategy_checks.evidence: a1 T2-T5 Sandslash moved first every turn under snow (Iron Head, Icicle Crash); a2 T5 Iron Head OHKO'd Xerneas.

strategy_checks.check: Chien-Pao Sword of Ruin + Sash + Sucker Punch
strategy_checks.evidence: Sacred Sword KO reads on Chi-Yu both attempts; Sucker Punch KO'd Flutter Mane a1 T8; Sash saved it a2 T3.

strategy_checks.check: Mega Baxcalibur Glaive Rush / High Horsepower
strategy_checks.evidence: a2: Baxcalibur (slot 6) entered with usable_gimmick=mega, mega_already_used=true after Froslass's Mega; never Mega Evolved (same defect as 325 #1). Its Icicle Crash into Rillaboom (368) was the right read.

protect_ledger.payoff: blocked Fake Out (would have flinched it)
blocked Kowtow Cleave (KO); Xerneas also Protected so Sandslash's Iron Head was wasted
blocked Thunderclap + Kowtow Cleave (both KOs); grassy terrain +21

ai_defects.description: Second authored Mega (Baxcalibur, mega_slots 4,6) never fired after Froslass Mega Evolved - same root cause as 325 defect 1 (HasTrainerUsedGimmick position-marking in src/battle_gimmick.c:120-126 gates the AI at src/battle_controllers.c:3304).

calibration: Lost a1 (party v1), won a2 (party v2) with 3 faints; real fight - keep all offsets (100/95/96/97/100/96 seeds -> medium 98/93/94/95/98/94).
cooler: Already cool: the Kyurem switch-out to dodge Fairy and the Mega Froslass re-snow both fired. It would be cooler still with the Baxcalibur Mega actually firing (engine defect). Ninetales' Encore was never used - Fake Out or a KO removed it both times; consider whether Icy Rock on Ninetales would make the first snow phase last long enough for Sandslash to matter more.
legality: No legality problem found in the authored set.
step_up: Yes - a clear step above Phoebe. Specs Kyurem's Earth Power OHKOs a 252 HP Incineroar from full, Slush Rush Sandslash outspeeds a +2 Geomancy Xerneas... (it does not: Xerneas +2 is faster, but Sandslash OHKOs it), and the Sash/Sword-of-Ruin Chien-Pao plus a re-snow Mega make the back half as dangerous as the front. v1 lost 3-6; v2 won 6-3.
